summary: All five round-1 findings are fixed, and I checked each fix against the archived sources. CAT-R1-01 (blocking) is closed. The cube README and manifest now describe ECC as distributed, GPU-resident per-BD FP32 (100,32,512,1024) cubes with shape, count, finite, populated-bin and empty-bin checks. They state that no export, MPI reduction or numerical-reference check is done (cube_exported, mpi_cube_reduced and numerical_reference_checked are all false), which matches PLAN.md:3-11 and scope.md:3-11. Export and reduction are attributed only to the failed bootstrap01 design. The metric is now marked provisional_unmeasured and its timing is application-specific. CAT-R1-02 is closed. I recomputed all six SDF storage/GPU cells from the cohort 45028778 full rows in runs.csv, and the n=3 counts, means, observed ranges and same-repeat paired speedups all match (for example Weka 2 GPUs: 0.9675×; NVMe 4 GPUs: 1.0185×). The six anchors span 1451.83–1667.02 events/s, as stated. CAT-R1-03 is closed: failed job 61384230 (15 s, 53-core intersection) matches status.json:30-37, is excluded from the tables, and status.json is now a hashed artifact. CAT-R1-04 is closed. check_catalog.py now: requires exact key sets for the summary cells (18/6/4 plus 48 SDF cells); checks links in the sources and templates READMEs; checks each manifest's site and workload against its directory path; and checks all four authored README tables against the source values. The replay tool's validate_population now reproduces the per-cohort full/pilot counts in build_report.py load_runs (16/12/20/20/8/8/18 full and 8/6/10/10/4/4/6 pilot), and also checks for duplicate cases and the cohort identities. The new test_archive_checks.py covers each of these. CAT-R1-05 is closed: the failed-job entry now records implementation 296d6998, review af2e612e and a pending failed-run review, matching status.json:9-42, and GC-R2-02 is carried over from gpu-check-round02.json. The pending cube record is still not promoted to results, and the original review states are retained (C++ passed, psana stripe pending, GPU scaling has no results review, SDF has four cohorts reviewed and three pending, synthesis unreviewed). I found no regressions in the other campaign records or the top-level docs. One low, non-blocking traceability note about validation.json is listed below.

SDF: recomputed by hand the means, min/max and same-repeat paired speedups for all six Weka/NVMe × 1/2/4-GPU cells, and the anchor range, from runs.csv lines 128-157
GPU scaling: checked the failed_jobs entry and README line 18 against notes/psana_gpu_scaling_20261116/status.json; confirmed status.json is a hashed artifact
check_catalog.py: read the expect_cells exact key-set logic, validate_location taxonomy, the extended link list, check_readme_table for the C++/stripe/scaling/SDF tables, and the pending-cube guard
replay_sdf_report.py: compared validate_population with build_report.py COHORTS and load_runs:92-102; the per-cohort sums match the 102 full / 48 pilot totals
test_archive_checks.py: traced all five tests. The drop/duplicate mutations reach expect_cells; the taxonomy, table, link and cohort-move cases raise the expected messages
Checked that the site/workload values in all five manifests match their directory paths and the FORMAT.md:3 taxonomy
Read README.md, FORMAT.md, catalog.json, tools/README.md, sources/README.md and validation.json for consistency and stale export or review claims
No commands or tests were executed; the catalog (380 hashes / 240 cases), regression (5 tests) and replay02 pass results come from the coordinator's validation.json
limitations: Read/Glob/Grep only. I did not run check_catalog.py, test_archive_checks.py or the replay, and I did not recompute any SHA256. The hash, test and replay passes rest on the supplied validation.json.

I did not independently confirm that the imported or native source bytes are unchanged since 2cd7d69c, because no diff tool was available. That claim rests on the hashes check_catalog.py checks and on the coordinator's statement.
I did not visually inspect the PDF/SVG heatmaps or the prior four-page render.
I did not re-read every IMPORTS.json entry or the 44-file cube byte match against af6ebc03.
Eight original SDF inputs are still not in the archive, so the SDF cohort review states rest on the archived REPORT.md and build_report.py COHORTS text.

findings.evidence: The 'sdf_replay_after_review' entry (lines 44-54) and 'regression_checks' (lines 31-43) give no output directory, timestamp or checked commit. The only replay_output (line 22) points to sdf-replay01, while response-01.md and the coordinator refer to replay02. Neither entry records the commit it was run against, so the round-2 evidence cannot be tied to a specific catalog state from the file alone.
findings.requested_change: Optional: add the replay02 output path, a UTC time and the git HEAD that was checked to the post-review replay and regression entries. They could also be added to a later record commit.
